item.title: Meta's smart glasses raise privacy alarms as data labelers review intimate recordings
item.description: The work, known as data labeling, is how Meta trains its computer vision systems. Each frame reviewed helps improve the algorithms powering its augmented reality assistant. Behind that feedback loop, however, human labor fills in the gaps machines still can't bridge.Read Entire Article

item.title: Lawmakers launch probe into hidden "eavesdropping" risks in modern computers
item.description: Senator Ron Wyden and Representative Shontel Brown have called on the Government Accountability Office to examine whether modern computers and phones remain vulnerable to what was once known as TEMPEST surveillance.Read Entire Article

item.title: DOJ seizes LeakBase, one of the world's biggest hacker forums
item.description: The Department of Justice describes LeakBase as a clearinghouse for hacked databases. Alongside the "hundreds of millions" of account credentials, it offers credit and debit card numbers, banking details, and other personally identifiable information that can fuel account takeovers and fraud.Read Entire Article

item.title: Scientists develop nanomaterial that targets cancer cells while sparing healthy tissue
item.description: Iron is essential to biological function, and iron-based nanomaterials may become valuable tools in the long-term effort to develop cancer treatments. Researchers at Oregon State University have engineered a new "nanoagent" using an iron-based metal-organic framework (MOF) structure and demonstrated its ability to destroy cancerous cells in laboratory experiments.Read Entire Article

item.description: On the surface, the change might look like semantics. item.title: Surging NAND costs could hurt Nintendo Switch 2 software sales
item.description: Many associate the NAND crisis with higher priced memory sticks for desktops or laptops, more expensive consumer electronics like Raspberry Pi hobby boards, and smartphones with less RAM than we are accustomed to. Companies like Nintendo also have to be cognizant of how the shortage will affect software sales.Read Entire Article

item.title: Microsoft confirms "Project Helix," a next-gen Xbox that runs both Xbox and PC games
item.description: Asha Sharma, who recently replaced Phil Spencer as the head of Microsoft's Xbox division, provided a short update on the company's next-generation console. Revealing the codename "Project Helix," she confirmed that the upcoming device aims to lead in horsepower and will support both Xbox and PC games.Read Entire Article

item.title: Nvidia says its investments in OpenAI and Anthropic are likely its last
item.description: Huang's explanation was brief, but the implications are broad.
